name: 캥카
light: In a broad sunlit stone rescue-station courtyard, adult woman in a grounded front three-quarter stance. Brown enamel slim plates, cream layered abdominal breastplate with a shallow curved pouch-like seam integrated into armor, dark gray crown trim and cream ear-shaped head ornaments. Thick tail shape becomes short layered brown waist sash, human anatomy and uncovered face. No infant, no companion, no second figure. Both open empty hands apart; full head and boots.
casual: At an empty indoor bouldering gym in bright noon light, bending forward slightly to tighten a red climbing-shoe lace on a low bench, hands clearly separated at opposite lace ends, one knee bent and face lifted toward viewer. No other climbers.
Opaque cream wide-strap athletic cropped tank with secure neckline, brown high-waisted fitted climbing shorts, low climbing shoes. Bare arms shoulders midriff and legs, tiny dark geometric ear studs.

At an empty motorsport paddock presentation platform at orange sunset, standing confidently with one open hand gesturing to a plain unlettered podium and the other relaxed away from her body. Entire woman and boots, warm track lights and empty pit buildings.

Original adult motorsport event-host fashion: opaque brown fitted sleeveless high-collar zip-front mini dress with cream side panels and securely covered chest, a short cropped cream bolero hanging over shoulders, tall dark ankle boots. Bare arms legs and small waist panels, tiny pouch-shaped pendant. No logos.

Inside an empty mountain rescue supply room on a cold rainy evening, seated at a workbench placing a rolled bandage into an open canvas first-aid kit with one hand while the other steadies its opposite rim. Head and both hands clear, warm task lamp and folded blankets.

Opaque cream deep but secure V-neck short-sleeve fitted wrap blouse with a brown waist tie and tailored brown shorts below crop. Bare forearms neck upper chest and narrow midriff, small black bead bracelet.

comparison.scope: Compared latest three completed characters on main: visually inspected all three Marowak casual images because no generation plan was present; read Chansey/Hoppip plans and six submitted prompts. Also reviewed Weezing/Rhydon/Sudowoodo and earlier batch characters.
